Definition: properly, perhaps to bow (the neck only in courtesy to an equal), i.e. to be kind; also (by euphemistically, but rarely) to reprove
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be good, be kind; 2a) (Hithpael) to show kindness to oneself; 2) to be reproached, be ashamed; 1a) (Piel) to be put to shame, be reproached
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
